description: GBA-2's devkitARM golden-gate proof: rebuilds nba-emu/hw-test's dma/latch/latch.gba unmodified from its pinned source and checks it against the binary nba shipped at that commit. Proves tools/rom-toolchain's devkitARM stage + devkitPro libgba reproduce this suite's toolchain byte-for-byte before GBA-3 patches it from source. Not the suite's real recipe (GBA-3 adds rom_variant: veloce patches across all 12 nba-hw-test ROMs); this one ROM exists to gate the toolchain, per docs/testing/testrom-plan.md GBA-2.
